reply.text:
That one's care, not coaching. I don't give doses for steroids, trenbolone included, and I won't set a "first time" number or a way to run it. Trenbolone is a serious drug with real risks, so a doctor is the right person to talk to, ideally one who can run bloodwork and look at your heart and health history.

What I can do is make your natural progress count. Tell me what you're chasing, whether that's size, strength or a lift number, and I'll look at where you are and build the training around it.
